stories.title: Diputada local del PT impulsa Día de Erradicación de la Gordofobia y el Gordoodio en CDMX; impulsan reformas que prohíban discriminación corporal

en.title: Local PT Congresswoman Promotes Day for Eradication of Weight-Based Discrimination and Hate in CDMX; Pushes Reforms to Ban Body Discrimination
en.summary: A local legislator is advocating for a day dedicated to eliminating weight-based discrimination and promoting related reforms. A national survey indicates that young people frequently experience discrimination based on weight and height.

stories.title: Trump no reembolsará dinero a contribuyentes por anuncios políticos de TV pese a críticas; Casa Blanca informa

en.title: Trump Will Not Reimburse Taxpayers for Political TV Advertisements Despite Criticism; White House Informs
en.summary: The U.S. president stated that he and his political campaign will cover the costs of television advertisements promoting him ahead of the November legislative elections.

stories.title: Integrantes de Timbiriche se deslindan de la serie de la banda: "No es la historia contada por nosotros"; no descartan contar su versión

en.title: Timbiriche Members Distance Themselves from Band Series: "It Is Not the Story Told by Us"; Do Not Rule Out Telling Their Version
en.summary: Members of the band Timbiriche stated they did not authorize the use of their names, images, or voices in a series about the group.

stories.title: Comisión de Derechos Humanos de CDMX investiga ocho quejas por hechos ocurridos durante marcha del 2 de octubre; dos son de periodistas

en.title: Mexico City Human Rights Commission Investigates Eight Complaints from October 2 Demonstration; Two Involve Journalists
en.summary: A human rights commission is investigating complaints arising from an October 2 march, including two from journalists. The commission noted that most participants demonstrated peacefully.

stories.title: Marcha Zombie de CDMX: ¿cuándo se realizará la siguiente edición?; consulta los detalles del evento

en.title: Zombie March of CDMX: when will the next edition take place?; check the event details
en.summary: Mexico City's horror-themed Zombie March event is free and open to all audiences, with the option for voluntary donations at designated booths.

stories.title: Hacienda asegura que UIF no investiga a Amílcar Olán; oposición cuestiona contratos y presunta red de huachicol

en.title: Treasury assures that UIF does not investigate Amílcar Olán; opposition questions contracts and alleged fuel theft network
en.summary: The Treasury minister stated that the financial intelligence unit conducts investigations according to judicial processes and denied any exceptions, while opposition members raised concerns about contracts and suspected illegal fuel trafficking.

stories.title: Quintana Roo anuncia digitalización de permisos de transporte de carga; trámites pasarán de 43 a cinco días

en.title: Quintana Roo announces digitalization of cargo transport permits; procedures will go from 43 to five days
en.summary: Quintana Roo state is implementing digital permits for cargo transportation, reducing processing time from 43 days to five days and modifying permit validity terms.

stories.title: Christa Pike está consciente y puede hablar tras intento de ejecución en Tennessee, dicen sus abogados; continúa hospitalizada

en.title: Christa Pike is conscious and can speak after execution attempt in Tennessee, her lawyers say; remains hospitalized
en.summary: Lawyers for Pike reported that the inmate remained conscious and hospitalized after surviving two doses of pentobarbital during an execution procedure in Tennessee.

stories.title: Con drones y vehículos blindados; entra en operación grupo de élite de la Guardia Civil en Michoacán

en.title: Elite Civil Guard group enters operation in Michoacán with drones and armored vehicles
en.summary: An elite special operations unit of Mexico's Civil Guard has begun operations in Michoacán, equipped with drones and armored vehicles to combat crime in the state.

stories.title: Niega Timbiriche haber autorizado serie sobre su historia

en.title: Timbiriche denies authorizing series about its history
en.summary: The band Timbiriche distanced itself from a new series about the group, stating it was neither consulted nor granted permission for the use of its image and identity.

stories.title: Christa Pike habla y está consciente tras fallida ejecución

en.title: Christa Pike speaks and is conscious after failed execution
en.summary: Christa Pike remained conscious and able to speak while receiving medical care after surviving two lethal injections in the United States.

stories.title: Con drones, unidades blindadas y tecnología, entra en acción policía de élite en Michoacán

en.title: With drones, armored units and technology, elite police force takes action in Michoacán
en.summary: Michoacán launched a new special operations group of the Civil Guard comprising over 100 trained personnel equipped with advanced technology to tackle crime and criminal activity.

stories.title: El peso mexicano se recupera y regresa a 17.95 por dólar; petróleo y bonos dan un respiro

en.title: Mexican peso recovers and returns to 17.95 per dollar; oil and bonds provide relief
en.summary: The Mexican currency strengthened after recent pressure, supported by declining oil prices and easing U.S. bond yields, which also boosted stock markets.

stories.title: Paramount y Warner Bros. ya son una sola empresa

en.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. are now one company
en.summary: Paramount Skydance completed its acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, creating a major media conglomerate that combines film studios, news networks, and streaming platforms including Paramount+ and HBO Max.

stories.title: ¿El SAT te debe dinero? La SCJN pone un límite a los intereses que puedes reclamar tras años de espera

en.title: Does the SAT owe you money? The SCJN sets a limit on interest you can claim after years of waiting
en.summary: Mexico's Supreme Court established guidelines for calculating interest owed when tax authorities delay refunding a favorable balance claimed by a taxpayer.

stories.title: Desde la Antártida llega el Nobel de Física 2026: un enorme cubo de hielo captura a los mensajeros del universo

en.title: From Antarctica comes the 2026 Physics Nobel: a massive ice cube captures the universe's messengers
en.summary: Francis Halzen received recognition for developing IceCube, an observatory located beneath Antarctic ice that has enabled detection of ultra-high-energy particles and their origins in space.

stories.title: Nuestra próxima tasa de interés podría decidirla un algoritmo

en.title: Our next interest rate could be decided by an algorithm
en.summary: Artificial intelligence will enable banks to better assess individual client risk, raising questions about transparency in how interest rates are determined for borrowers.
